# Roboto Mono

The website bundles a Cyrillic/Latin subset of the Roboto Mono variable font so
the HTML startup shell and Compose use identical monospace metrics on every host.

- Source: `RobotoMono[wght].ttf` from the Google Fonts `ofl/robotomono` directory
- Source SHA-256: `66a80e79d17e4c7cabd162e2916578a4cc08fd19eef6e2a643305eae9c567b2b`
- Subset Unicode ranges: `U+0000-00FF,U+0400-052F`
- Bundled SHA-256: `e7069fe300d4629bd360bd2c0885f2b5594fcc41d0120b98955025255450f0db`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)

The subset was generated with fonttools `pyftsubset`, retaining all layout
features, variation axes, and font name records.
